name: Digital Realty ZAG1 Zagreb Data Center
notes: Digital Realty lists ZAG1 in Zagreb with 2 MW utility power; operational carrier-neutral colocation facility.

name: Digital Realty ZAG2 Zagreb Campus Expansion
notes: Digital Realty announced acquisition of land in Zagreb for a second facility/campus adjacent to ZAG1; capacity not disclosed in available announcement.

name: A1 Croatia Zagreb Data Center
notes: A1 markets Zagreb data-center and cloud services; directory listing identifies the Zagreb facility with roughly 350 kW power.

name: Hrvatski Telekom Zagreb Remete Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute lists HT Data Center Zagreb in Zagreb; Siemens described a modernization project at Croatian Telecom's Zagreb data center.

name: SRCE/HR-ZOO Zagreb 2 Data Center
developer: University Computing Centre, University of Zagreb (SRCE)
notes: SRCE opened a new HR-ZOO infrastructure data center at Josipa Marohnica 5 in Zagreb for research and higher-education computing.

name: DataBox Zagreb-Zitnjak Data Center
notes: DataBox markets a purpose-built data center in Zagreb's Zitnjak industrial zone; no reliable MW capacity found.

name: Data Target Buzin Data Center
notes: Directory sources place Data Target Buzin in the Zagreb area with about 500 kW; Comping markets associated data-center services.

name: Altus IT Colocation Data Center Zagreb
notes: Altus IT offers colocation in Zagreb; public sources did not disclose power capacity.

name: Akton Zagreb Data Center
notes: Akton offers data-center services in Zagreb; capacity not published in accessible primary materials.

name: Cloudflare Zagreb Edge Data Center
notes: Cloudflare announced a Zagreb edge data center/PoP; listed as operational CDN/network infrastructure rather than wholesale colocation.
